description: An email arrives that the classifier marks important. The watcher (server/services/gmail/importance_watcher.py::_poll_tenant) calls classify_email_importance, which issues one LLM call against the mark_email_importance tool schema. On a decided+summarized verdict the watcher awaits _dispatch_summary, which calls InteractionAgentRuntime.handle_agent_message -- a second LLM call that relays the summary to the user via send_message_to_user.

email.subject: Your flight has been cancelled
email.clean_text: Flight AB123 on 2026-07-22 has been cancelled. Please rebook.

arguments.summary: Your flight AB123 on 2026-07-22 was cancelled; you need to rebook.

arguments.message: Heads up: your flight AB123 on 2026-07-22 was cancelled. You'll need to rebook.
